ei.title: Originality: The Key to Great Composers
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.

questions.passage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were (A)[misunderstood / celebrated] in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this (B)[initial / final] lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely (C)[old / new]. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① misunderstood — initial — new: 원문 일치. 위대한 작곡가들이 오해받았고(misunderstood), 초기(initial)의 수용 부족이 있었으며, 음악 형식이 완전히 새로웠다(new)는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② celebrated — initial — new: (A) celebrated(칭송받은)는 misunderstood(오해받은)와 반대
❌ ③ misunderstood — final — new: (B) final(마지막의)은 initial(초기의)과 반대
❌ ④ misunderstood — initial — old: (C) old(오래된)는 new(새로운)와 반대
det.tip: were misunderstood / initial lack of acceptance / completely new

questions.passage:
(A) The old machine does not <u>work</u> properly anymore after the accident.
(B) He wasn't a great composer because his <u>work</u> wasn't original.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)에서 밑줄 친 work의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 작품 — (B) 작동하다: (A)는 '작동하다', (B)는 '작품'으로 서로 바뀜
❌ ② (A) 작동하다 — (B) 직장: (B)의 work는 '직장'이 아니라 '작품'
✅ ③ (A) 작동하다 — (B) 작품: (A)는 기계가 '작동하다'라는 동사, (B)는 작곡가의 '작품'이라는 명사로 다의어의 두 의미를 올바르게 연결 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) 노동 — (B) 운동하다: (A)는 동사 '작동하다'이지 명사 '노동'이 아님
det.tip: work: ① (동사) 작동하다/일하다 ② (명사) 작품/일

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who writes music"

det.analysis:
❌ ① acceptance: acceptance(수용)는 사람이 아닌 받아들임
❌ ② form: form(형식)은 사람이 아닌 양식
❌ ③ host: host(진행자/주인)는 음악을 쓰는 사람이 아님
✅ ④ composer: composer(작곡가)는 음악을 쓰는 사람으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: composer = 작곡가. a person who writes music이 핵심

questions.passage: The musical forms, or ideas __________ (express) within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: express → expressed: 명사 ideas를 수동으로 수식하는 과거분사
det.analysis: 'ideas __________ (express) within them'에서 ideas가 '표현된' 수동 관계이므로 과거분사 expressed가 ideas를 뒤에서 수식한다. express → expressed
det.tip: 명사 + 과거분사 = 수동 수식. ideas expressed within them(그 안에 표현된 생각)

questions.passage: Some of the greatest composers were __________ (misunderstand) in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'composers were __________ (misunderstand)'는 'be동사 + 과거분사'의 수동태이다. 작곡가들이 '오해받은' 수동 의미이고, misunderstand의 과거분사는 불규칙 변화로 misunderstood이다. misunderstand → misunderstood
det.tip: misunderstand-misunderstood-misunderstood (불규칙). were misunderstood(오해받았다)

questions.passage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial __________ is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely overshadowed by him. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: lack of acceptance=수용 부족 — 초기의 수용 부족의 이유가 낯섦이라는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① lack of acceptance: 원문 일치. 초기의 수용 부족(lack of acceptance)의 이유가 낯섦이라는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② love of music: love of music(음악 사랑)은 수용 부족과 반대
❌ ③ fear of failure: fear of failure(실패에 대한 두려움)는 본문 맥락과 무관
❌ ④ sense of pride: sense of pride(자부심)는 수용 부족의 맥락과 다름
det.tip: The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity

questions.passage: You hear again and again that some of the greatest composers were misunderstood in their own day. Not everyone could understand the compositions of Beethoven, Brahms, or Stravinsky in their day. The reason for this initial lack of acceptance is unfamiliarity. The musical forms, or ideas expressed within them, were completely new. And yet, this is exactly one of the things that makes them so great. Effective composers have their own ideas. Have you ever seen the classic movie Amadeus? The composer Antonio Salieri is the "host" of this movie; he's depicted as one of the most famous non-great composers — he lived at the time of Mozart and was completely __________. Now, Salieri wasn't a bad composer; in fact, he was a very good one. But he wasn't one of the world's great composers because his work wasn't original. What he wrote sounded just like what everyone else was composing at the time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: overshadowed by him=그에게 가려진 — Salieri가 모차르트에게 완전히 가려졌다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① admired around the world(전 세계의 찬사): 모차르트에게 가려졌다는 맥락과 반대
✅ ② overshadowed by him(그에게 가려진): Salieri가 모차르트 시대에 살며 그에게 완전히 가려졌다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ③ remembered for many centuries(여러 세기 동안 기억된): 가려진 처지와 반대
❌ ④ praised by every critic(모든 평론가의 찬사): 가려졌다는 맥락과 반대
det.tip: was completely overshadowed by him (그에게 완전히 가려졌다)
